extraction.notes: Comparator extraction for RI-TEC-036 only (LIM-0026). Filed under Albania as agreed; items carry the country they concern (ALB or MNE). Disclaimer on page 2: responsibility rests solely with the author (Vesna Tintor, Spring Advisory); the content cannot be taken to reflect the views of the Regional Cooperation Council. Speaker is recorded as the publisher. Indicator definitions (page 19): e-Government users is the share of individuals who used the internet in the previous 12 months to interact with public authorities, so it covers any online contact and is not specific to a portal or to completed transactions; the citizens indicator scores whether life-event services can be fully completed online, provide adequate information and are reachable through central portals. Starred scores are "Calculated based on desk research from 2025". The Albania section does not mention Law 43/2023 or any obligation to use the portal. WB6-wide claims (pages 7-9, 18-19) and the North Macedonia profile are not extracted. Other digital skills, infrastructure and business indicators are out of scope; two basic skills rows are kept with theme_doubtful. Second pass by checker-I: see review/RUN-2026-01/run1b/second_pass/ALB-IO-2026-001.csv.
